```yaml
name: Third‑Party Dependency Updates

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  github-actions-update:
    name: Update GitHub Actions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: npm install -g pnpm
      - run: pnpm install
      - run: pnpm run update-github-actions
      - uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: 'chore: update GitHub Actions'
          branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          file_pattern: .github/workflows/*.yml

  general-js-deps:
    name: Update JavaScript Dependencies
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: npm install -g pnpm
      - run: pnpm install
      - run: pnpm run update-js-deps
      - uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: 'chore: update JavaScript dependencies'
          branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          file_pattern: package.json pnpm-lock.yaml
```
